name: delori_aa
label: delta Ori Aa1 (Mintaka, O9.5 II; eclipsing 5.73 d)
sources: Wikipedia infobox (read 2026-10-08) and the papers it cites: V 2.23, O9.5 II + B eclipsing pair (5.73 d), T_eff 31400 K, R 13.1 Rsun, M 17.8 Msun, d 382 pc
notes: No interferometric diameter exists: theta_LD = 2R/d = 0.319 mas from the quoted radius and distance; the Pathfinder would be its first measurement.
Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law of Spica (hot B star) as the limb-darkening fallback; NewEra does not cover T_eff > 12 000 K.
V 2.23 is Aa + Ab (2.50 + 3.90); the Aa1 primary dominates. Distance 382 pc (cluster / spectroscopic) against the Hipparcos 212 +/- 30 pc: the diameter scales with it.
Aa1-Aa2 eclipsing orbit: a 40.1 Rsun, i 79.1 deg, e 0.081.

summary.components: O9.5 II + B eclipsing pair (5.73 d)
